summary: FE iteration 4. Added 11 new features from iter002 domain research that were never included: official Belgian/Flemish public holidays (is_official_public_holiday, is_day_before_holiday), all Flemish school holiday periods (herfstvakantie, kerstvakantie, krokusvakantie, paasvakantie, zomervakantie), Gentse Feesten, and short lag features (bread_lag_1d, bread_lag_2d, bread_lag_3d). Output: iteration_019_feature_engineering.csv (2897 x 90 cols). Herfstvakantie, Kerstvakantie, and official holidays appear directly in the fold-3 val period (Sep-Dec 2020), making them immediately testable.

val_period_coverage.note: Herfstvakantie and Kerstvakantie periods fall directly in all 3 fold val periods (Sep-Dec). Official holidays Nov 1, Nov 11, Dec 25 all appear in fold-3 val.

handoff.read_this_first: New FE CSV is iteration_019_feature_engineering.csv with 90 columns. All models in iter020 must use this new CSV. Key new features: is_official_public_holiday, is_herfstvakantie, is_kerstvakantie, bread_lag_1d/2d/3d. These appear in fold-3 val so they are directly testable.

durable_rules.rule: All training from iter020 onward uses iteration_019_feature_engineering.csv (90 cols), not iter012 (79 cols).
durable_rules.why: 11 domain-recommended features added, including holiday and school break features directly in the val period.
